title: Slovakian Springy Kissed Cake
description: A moist and flavorful cake infused with the sweetness of spring and a hint of Slovakian charm.
instructions: Grease two 8-inch round cake pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, ground almonds, and a pinch of salt.
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the honey and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla extract.
With the mixer on low speed, gradually add the flour mixture to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Divide the batter evenly between the prepared pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow the cakes to cool in the pans for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once the cakes are completely cool, you can frost and decorate them as desired.
